description: One-call natural hazard report for a US address or coordinates: overall risk and its drivers, FEMA flood zone and flood-insurance requirement, ratings for wildfire, hurricane, tornado, heat, flooding, earthquake and more, and the county's disaster history. Use when evaluating, listing, insuring or financing a property, or when asked about flood zones or natural hazard risk at an address. Not charged if the address can't be found. Costs $0.02 (x402, USDC on Base).
